questions.q: Do I need an ID to register to vote in Nebraska?
questions.a:
Some registration methods in Nebraska may ask for additional information to help election officials verify your registration.

Online (https://www.nebraska.gov/apps-sos-voter-registration/): You will be asked to enter your Nebraska driver’s license or state ID number. If you do not have one, you can register using a paper form instead.

In person (https://absentee.vote411.org/vote/eoddomestic.htm): You can register at your county election office. You do not need to bring an ID or other documents to register in person. If you do not have a Nebraska driver’s license or state ID, you may provide the last four digits of your Social Security number instead.

By mail (https://sos.nebraska.gov/voter-forms): If you are registering to vote in Nebraska for the first time by mail, including a copy of a photo ID or a document showing your name and current address dated within the last 60 days can help avoid delays. Examples include a utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document.
